product_family: AI video generator (text-to-video and image-to-video). Consumer-facing product ceased operations February 2025. Technology subsequently acquired by NetMind.AI and repositioned for B2B infrastructure.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Pre-shutdown privacy policy and DPA (data-processing-agreement-04062024.html) reference GDPR Article 28(3) mandatory clauses for controller-processor relationships, but no formal GDPR compliance certification held. Company appointed a data privacy manager and maintained a sub-processor list compliant with GDPR transfer mechanisms, but this is posture, not third-party certification.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found. Not a healthcare-focused vendor; no HIPAA coverage claimed.

privacy.ai_training_note: Pre-shutdown privacy policy stated: 'Aggregated Data is used to train the Application's AI model(s).' The policy also stated 'Only Application Usage Data and Other Source Data is utilised to train the Application's AI model(s)' and that Haiper did not use User Content Data (personal data) to train its models. An opt-out was documented: 'You may opt-out of Haiper's use of Application Usage Data to train the Application's AI model(s) by contacting them.' Anonymised Aggregated Data was used by default and, being non-personal, was not subject to the opt-out.
privacy.data_region: Primary UK/EU based (Haiper Limited UK company, maintained GDPR-compliant data transfer mechanisms including adequacy regulations and Article 46 safeguards).

security.name: Data Encryption in Transit
security.value: Yes; acknowledged in pre-shutdown privacy materials that 'technologically and organisationally appropriate security measures' including encryption were in place to prevent unauthorised access or disclosure.

security.name: Data Encryption at Rest
security.value: Likely (encryption mentioned in privacy materials) but not explicitly detailed in public documentation.

security.name: Data Sale Prohibition
security.value: Privacy policy stated Haiper 'does not share personal data (including any User Content Data) with private third parties for their own purposes (commercial or otherwise).' Third-party service providers contractually prohibited from using personal data for their own purposes.

security.name: Content Moderation
security.value: Hybrid (ML + human): Advanced machine learning algorithms detect NSFW content; team of human moderators work in shifts to monitor user content.

security.name: Data Privacy Officer
security.value: Appointed to oversee personal data processing and GDPR compliance; users could lodge complaints with UK ICO or relevant data protection regulator.

security.name: Sub-processor Oversight
security.value: Maintained a Sub-processor List (as required by GDPR Article 28); sub-processors contractually bound to respect individual rights and assist with data subject access requests.

products.name: Haiper Video Generator (Consumer)
products.data_scope: User text prompts, reference images, and generated videos. Platform trained on aggregated user data for model improvement.
products.notes: Shut down February 2025. No login required (optional); did not require sensitive personal data upload. Encrypted transmission. No subscription data sharing with third parties.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (pre-shutdown): free tier with limited credits, paid subscription for more video generation capacity
compare.data_residency: UK/EU (Haiper Limited UK company; maintained GDPR-compliant cross-border transfer mechanisms per Article 46 GDPR)

flags: The company ceased consumer operations in February 2025 and its technology was acquired by NetMind.AI. The information here reflects pre-shutdown evidence only.
No public SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other formal third-party security or compliance certifications were found; only a GDPR-compliant DPA and privacy posture were documented.

The privacy policy explicitly stated that Aggregated Data and Application Usage Data were used for model training. An opt-out for Application Usage Data training was documented (by contacting Haiper); anonymised Aggregated Data was used by default. Keep this AI training posture in mind when evaluating the vendor's historical practices.

Haiper Limited (UK company number 13515940) is confirmed via Companies House. The consumer product (haiper.ai) and the B2B infrastructure business (NetMind.AI) are distinct entities following the acquisition.

The company raised $32M in seed funding, which proved insufficient to cover sustained GPU compute costs plus free-tier access in the competitive 2024-2025 generative video market, pointing to scalability and financial viability risk during that period.
